why: RJ-L55 (share-sheet SH-3c): drops three geotagged JPEGs (GPS, body and lens serial numbers, a maker note) on the catalog, which selects them, and prepares them for the share sheet. Each copy is a JPEG at quality 85 with a long edge of 2048, written without the location properties; a relaunch empties Share/. Pending #3741: the CLI keeps file commands window-only; LibrarySharePrepTests runs these steps on Linux through the fake exporter and writer, then writes the files the command names and runs the launch cleanup.
